worldcombat.skill.scaryface.summary: Startle one foe in range into stepping back and moving slowly for a short time. Its Speed returns when the frightened status ends.
worldcombat.skill.scaryface.use.0: Stop the fastest, most troublesome enemy
worldcombat.skill.scaryface.use.1: Slow a foe down before it closes in
worldcombat.skill.scaryface.use.2: Buy time for an ally to pull away
Lowers Speed by up to %1$s stages for %2$s; Speed returns when the status ends or is cleared.
Startles a target within %1$s, pushing it %2$s blocks away from you on impact.
Turning to face the target takes %1$s, with a %2$s cooldown.
Scary Face needs a real line of sight: when the target is behind a wall, cover or another obstruction the glare stops on it, deals nothing and pushes nobody.
worldcombat.skill.scaryface.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.scaryface.preference.a: The companion only considers glaring while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it at point-blank, larger starts sooner.
When on, the companion may leave its post to glare under a Hold order.
world_combat.move.scaryface.text.blocked: Line of sight blocked; the scare misses
worldcombat.skill.scaryface.reapply: A target already carrying this slow cannot be targeted by Scary Face again, and a target that cannot lose stat stages is unaffected.
